statement: Run the same installed library against different projects without reading the library source checkout, leaking state or restoring hidden defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: One configured project context reaches every gate/store/adapter; a sentinel configuration test detects any nested factory reverting to repository defaults.
AC-02: The runtime works without copied core schemas in the consumer and from an unrelated current working directory.
AC-03: Two projects with identical task IDs and distinct roots cannot share locks, state, evidence or exchange by accident; invalid/escaping roots reject before writes.
AC-04: A non-npm consumer executes only its declared validators; Windows paths with spaces and command arguments work without shell interpolation.
AC-05: Current role context, exact-revision artifacts, history durability and fail-closed behavior are preserved.
AC-06: Initialization is repeatable/non-destructive and doctor reports missing tools, assets, config or incompatible storage clearly.
